advice.claim: Customers often mistakenly believe the hottest bed is the most effective, requiring staff to educate them that extreme heat does not equal a better tan.
advice.quote: their staff gets a customer walking in the door and says I want the hottest bed you've got because they believe it's the best way. So the salon staff needs to understand and educate and change people's mind

advice.claim: Customers often mistake the immediate heat sensation of a tanning bed for actual pigmentation, which actually takes several hours to develop.
advice.quote: Heat is not doesn't mean tanning, and a lot of the time, when you get out of a very hot bed and you dye the gray colors, it is not pigmentation, it is heat, because the tanning and the delineation, delineation of the surface, it doesn't happen in 10 minutes, it happens in multiple hours.
